description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the WorkShiftService in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing functions related to managing work shifts such as saving, retrieving all, and retrieving by ID.

classes.name: WorkShiftServiceTest
classes.description: Test class for the WorkShiftService, testing creation, retrieval, and listing of work shifts within the system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment and loads fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testSaveWorkShift
methods.description: Tests the saving of a WorkShift object via the WorkShiftDao mock.

methods.name: testGetAllWorkShifts
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of WorkShift objects based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific WorkShift by its ID.
